title: Self-designed doctorate in parapsychology at UC Berkeley

tellings.quote: And so that's how I ended up seven years later earning a doctoral degree in parasychology.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove says that in the 1970s he designed his own doctoral programme at the University of California, Berkeley, and seven years later earned a doctorate in parapsychology, the study of claimed psychic abilities. He tells Michels this as his own path, and it would make his an unusual degree from a mainstream university.
